t: This is 14 Templewood Avenue, a twentieth-century house in Hampstead. It was designed by C. H. B. Quennell, an English architect, designer, illustrator and historian. A heritage architect, Cath Layton, says his great influence can be felt in the houses and streets of London's suburbs and across the country. He also wrote books for children and young people, which a Nature obituary said strongly stimulated interest in the cultural background of history. So this is a house by a man of many talents.
